propositions: Jira Data Center's built-in rate limiting (429 responses with Retry-After headers) is not honoured by rebar's DC transport, causing hard failures instead of retries

The transport's single retry choke point _with_connection_retry fronts all call sites including mutations like create_issue, so retrying 429s there would reintroduce duplicate-issue failures already fixed
The 429 retry policy must scope to idempotent reads only via per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF, ensuring mutations fail fast and prevent duplicates when 429 arrives after server begins a write
transport.py is at its 800-line locked cap with only 11 lines headroom, forcing the retry/error cluster to extract to a separate module before new policy can be added
Exhausted 429 retries must raise BackendHTTPError(code=429) through the existing _as_backend_http_error translation boundary, never leak raw JIRAError vendor types to callers
